headline: Approved a lease of the Broad and North Union streets parking lot to News Café; approved a pay rate for parking enforcement officers.
summary: Approved an easement with Narragansett Electric Company for an underground distribution system at 100 Freight Street. Confirmed five appointments to city boards and commissions. Directed the clerk to send letters about a dirt pile on Grenville Street and repairs on Smithfield Avenue.
decisions: Approved the minutes of earlier meetings as prepared by the Clerk.
Approved the consent agenda on a unanimous voice vote.
Referred to the Finance Committee a pay rate ordinance for Local 3960 after it was laid on the table.
Approved sending Blackstone Center a request for information on the dirt and debris pile on Grenville Street.
Approved a letter to RI Energy thanking it and asking it to speed up Smithfield Avenue repairs.
Council President Mercer asked the Finance Committee chair to schedule another meeting on the teachers' contract.
Confirmed Ann Marie Braganca to the Parks Commission, 7-0.
Confirmed Dorine Havandjian to the Advisory Commission on Arts and Culture, 6-0.
Confirmed Suzette Wordell to the Advisory Commission on Arts and Culture, 7-0.
Confirmed Michael William Cooper to the Pension Board, 5-1.
Confirmed the reappointment of Lydia Perez to the Public Arts Fund Committee, 7-0.
Approved a six-month lease, then month-to-month, with News Café for the parking lot on Broad Street and North Union Street, 7-0.
Approved an easement with Narragansett Electric Company for an underground distribution system at 100 Freight Street, 7-0.
Approved on second reading, 7-0, a pay rate for parking enforcement officers for Local 3960.
